verses.en: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: AUA tou te faia ni tupua mo outou, aua foi tou te faatuina se tupua ua ta, po o se tupua maa, aua foi tou te tuu se faatagata maa i lo outou nuu, e ifo atu i ai; auā o a‘u o Ieova lo outou Atua.

verses.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verses.sm: la outou tausiusi i o‘u sapati, ma outou matatau i lo‘u malumalu; o a‘u o Ieova.

verses.en: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
verses.sm: Afai tou te savavali i a‘u tulafono, ma tausi i a‘u poloaiga, ma fai ai;

verses.en: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.sm: ona ou avatu ai lea le ua ia te outou i ona po e tatau ai, e fua mai foi le laueleele i ona lava fua, o laau foi o i le fanua e fua mai ai i o latou fua.

verses.en: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.sm: E aulia le taugāvine e le soligāsaito; e aulia foi le tau e lulu ai saito e le taugavine, tou te aai foi i a outou mea e ‘ai, ma maoona ai; tou te nonofo foi i lo outou nuu ma le filemu.

verses.en: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.sm: Ou te avatu le filemu i le nuu, tou te taooto foi, e leai se tasi e faamatau ia te outou; ou te faaumatia foi manu feai ai le nuu, e le oo foi le pelu i lo outou nuu.

verses.en: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.sm: Tou te tulituliloa foi i e o fai outou mo latou fili, latou te oti ai i o outou luma i le pelu.

verses.en: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.sm: E tulia le toaselau e le toalima o outou, e tulia foi le sefulu o afe e le toaselau o outou; o e fai outou mo latou fili e oti i latou i o outou luma i le pelu.

verses.en: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
verses.sm: Auā ou te manatu alofa ia te outou, ou te faauluolaina outou, ma faatoateleina, ou te faatumauina foi la‘u feagaiga 'ia te outou.

verses.en: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
verses.sm: Tou te aai i mea tuai, ma outou ave i fafo mea tiiai ona o mea fou.

verses.en: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
verses.sm: Ou te tuu foi lo‘u malumalu i totonu ia te outou; e le ‘inouiio foi a‘u ia te ou tou.

verses.en: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
verses.sm: Ou te fealuai foi i totonu ia te outou, e fai foi a‘u mo outou Atua, e fai foi outou mo‘u nuu.

verses.en: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
verses.sm: O a‘u o Ieova lo outou Atua, o le na au mai ia te le fai outou mo latou pologa; na ou gauia o a outou amo, ma ua faasavavali sasa‘o ai outou.

verses.en: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
verses.sm: A e afai tou te le faalogo mai ia te au, ma outou le faia ia poloaiga uma:

verses.en: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:
verses.sm: afai foi tou te lafoai i a‘u tulafono, ma outou ʻinoʻino i a‘u faamasinoga, a outou le faia foi a‘u poloaiga uma, a e tuumavaega outou i la‘u feagaiga;

verses.en: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.sm: ona ou faia lea e a‘u o nei mea ia te outou; ou te tuuina atu ia te outou le fefe, o le ma‘i faaiiva, ma le ma‘i vevela e fole ai mata, ma faavaivai ai loto; tou te lulufuaina a outou saito, auā e ‘aina e i latou o e fai outou mo latou fili.

verses.en: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
verses.sm: Ou te faia outou mo‘u fili, e fasia foi outou i luma o e ita ia te outou; e pule foi ia te outou e o ‘ino‘ino ia te outou; e sosola foi outou a o le tuliloaina e se tasi.

verses.en: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
verses.sm: Afai foi tou te le āu faalogo mai ia te au ona o ia mea, ona ou faaopoopo faafitu ai lea ona aoai atu ia te outou ona o a outou agasala.

verses.en: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
verses.sm: Ou te nutipalaina lo outou malosi ua outou mitamita ai; ou te liliu ai lo outou lagi e pei o le uamea, ma lo outou laueleele e pei o le ‘apa memea.

verses.en: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
verses.sm: E faamaumau fua foi 3o outou malosi; auā e le fua mai ni ona fua i lo outou laueleele, o laau foi i lo outou fanua e le fua mai ai ni o latou fua.

verses.en: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
verses.sm: Afai foi tou te tetee mai ia te au, ma outou le faalogo mai lava ia te au, ona ou faaopoopo faafitu ai lea o mala ia te outou e tusa ma a outou agasala.

verses.en: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
verses.sm: Ou te aauina atu foi o manu feai ia te outou, e āufanaua ai outou, ma faaumatia a outou manu, ma faatoaitiiti ia te outou; e gaogao foi o outou ala.

verses.en: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
verses.sm: Afai foi e le mafai ona aoaiina outou e a‘u i mea ia, a e tetee mai outou ia te au;

verses.en: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
verses.sm: ona ou tetee atu ai lea ia te outou, ma ou aoai faafituina atu ia te outou ona o a outou agasala.

verses.en: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.sm: Ou te faaoo foi le pelu ia te outou, e taui atu ai lo outōu tuumavaega i le feagaiga; a faapotopotoina outou i a outou aai, ou te au atu ai le faama‘i ia te outou e tuuina atu foi outou i lima o e fai outou mo latou fili.

verses.en: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.sm: A uma ona ou gauia le tootoo o a outou mea e ‘ai, ona tao ai lea e fafine e toasefulu a iatou te toe avatu foi a outou mea e ‘ai ua uma ona fuatia, tou te aai foi, a e le maoona ai.

verses.en: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
verses.sm: A e afai tou te le faalogo mai lava ia te au ona o ia mea, a e tetee mai pea ia te au;

verses.en: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.sm: ona ou tetee atu ai lea ia te outou ma le ita; o a‘u lava ou te aoai faafitu ia te outou ona o a outou agasala.

verses.en: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
verses.sm: Tou te aai foi i tino o outou atalii, ma tino o outou afafine tou te aai ai.

verses.en: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
verses.sm: Ou te faaumatia a outou mea maualuluga, ma vavae i lalo a outou tupua o le la, ma au lafo o outou tino ua oti i luga o tino o a outou tupua, e inosia foi outou e a‘u.

verses.en: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
verses.sm: Ou te faatafunaina foi a outou aai, ma faatafunaina o outou malumalu, e le oo mai foi ia te au le manogi o a outou mea manogi lelei.

verses.en: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
verses.sm: Ou te faatafunaina le nuu; e taufaiofo o e nonofo ai e o fai outou mo latou fili.

verses.en: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
verses.sm: Ou te faataapeape foi ia te outou i nuu ese, ou te to ae le pelu e mulimuli atu ia te outou; e faagaogao lo outou fanua, e faatafunaina foi a outou aai.

verses.en: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
verses.sm: Ona faaatoatoaina lea o sapati o le laueleele i aso uma e gaogao ai, a o i ai outou i le nuu o e fai outou mo latou fili; o ona po ia e mapu ai le laueleele, ma faaatoatoa ai ona sapati.

verses.en: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
verses.sm: O aso uma e gaogao ai e mapu ai ia; auā na le mapu i o outou sapati ina ua outou nonofo ai.

verses.en: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
verses.sm: O e ua totoe foi ou te faaoo ai le vaivai i o latou loto i nuu o e fai i latou mo latou fili; e tulia i latou i le gase o le lau mea e lelea; latou te sosola ai e pei ona sosola tagata ai le pelu; latou te pauu foi a o lei tuliloaina e se tasi.

verses.en: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.sm: E pauu foi i latou le tasi i luga o le tasi, e peiseai o i luma o le pelu a o lei tuliloaina e se tasi; e leai foi so outou malosi e tetee atu ai i e o fai outou mo latou fili.

verses.en: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.sm: E fano foi outou i nuu ese, e ‘aina foi outou e le laueleele o e fai outou mo latou fili.

verses.en: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
verses.sm: O e totoe ia te outou e faaumatia ai i latou ona o a latou amio leaga i nuu o e fai outou mo latou fili; ona o le amio leaga foi a o latou tamā e faaumatia ai i latou.

verses.en: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
verses.sm: Afai latou te faaali ai i a latou amio leaga, ma amio leaga a o latou tamā atoa ma lo latou solitulafono ua latou soli ai la‘u tulafono, ma latou tetee mai ia te au;

verses.en: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
verses.sm: ma ou tetee atu ia i latou, Ua avea foi i lātoU e a£U i le nuu o e fai i latou mo latou fili, pe afai e iu ina faamaulalo ai o latou loto e le peritomeina, ina ua latou faaatoatoaina le totogi o a latou amio leaga;

verses.en: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.sm: ona ou manatua ai lea o la£u feagaiga ma Iakopo ma la£u feagaiga ma Isaako, atoa foi ma la£u feagaiga ma Aperaamo ou te mana- tua ai, ou te manatua ai foi le nuU.

verses.en: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.sm: E tuua le laueleele e i latou, e faaatoatoa ai foi ona sapati, ina o tuufua e le o i ai i latou; ma ua latou faaatoatoaina le totogi o a latou amio leaga; ona o lenei lava mea ina ua latou lafoai a£u faamasinoga, auā foi na latou £ino£ino i a£u tulafono.

verses.en: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.
verses.sm: A e ui lava i nei mea, a o i ai I latou i le nuu o e fai i latou mo latou fili, ou te le lafoai ia i latou, ou te le £ino£ino foi ia i latou, ia matuā faaumatia, ma tatalaina ai la£u feagaiga ma i latou; auā o a£u o Ieova lo latou Atua.

verses.en: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.
verses.sm: A e peitai ona o i latou ou te manatua ai le feagaiga ma o latou tamā, na ou aumaia nai le nuu o Aikupito i luma o nuu ese ina ia fai a£u mo latou Atua; o a£u o ieova.

verses.en: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
verses.sm: O sauniga ma faamasinoga ma tulafono ia, na tuuina ai e Ieova i lo latou va ma le fanauga a Isaraelu i le mauga o Sinai i le lima o Mose.
